_comment: 2026-07-26 Act V canonical, THE TALK PATH. Loads seal_fed_start (warrior5/mage5 + diplomat1, so [Charming Smile] is KNOWN and the witch-pattern Skill leg is selectable rather than a locked tease) via title Continue. Flow: the descent ask -> the skill-free reading at the seal -> Pisces argues the ward is safer fed and points at Olesm -> the Guild steps, where the standing Watch posting is argued into existence. NEGATIVES throughout: agreeing at the door banks nothing, the door never opens (seal_opened absent), the re-ward counter never banks, and combat_started never fires in the whole run. FINALE LEG (Phase 8): this canonical carries the ending's proof -- the closing sequence fires off the resolving dialogue's end at 10 lines (fed close), banks the finale_played one-shot, and declines to re-fire at the following sleep.

steps._comment: Down to Continue; confirm loads the seal_fed_start manual slot.

== ACT V IS ALREADY LIVE == the pilgrimage's third lattice piece plus the seal report is the act_iv gate, and this fixture holds both. The journal reads Act V before the player has done anything about it.

steps._comment: == THE DESCENT ASK == Pisces (30,4). Bump up to face him; first interact = talk_pool line, second opens pisces_magic (spine_reach's own approach).

Greet pin: the lattice_forge_rune variant wins by last-match-wins, and neither Act V greet arm is reachable yet. The exact option array is pinned per build below (this save's kit changes which rows render).

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: A Drake forge taught you in an afternoon what my tuition has been circling for a month. They feed their runes. Feed them, on a schedule. Maintenance, they call it. I am revising my rates. Downward. The new schedule is chalked on my slate already.

steps._comment: The pool-line panel is still closing as the graph opens; a confirm injected into that same frame is swallowed by its dismissal (cost one authoring cycle). Settle first, THEN drive the option cursor.
He assembles three regions' worth of the same word and asks to read the seal in person. The treatise leg is an OR-enrichment this save never took, so the base text is the one that renders.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Three regions taught you the same word in three accents and not one of them noticed doing it. A witch feeds hers, milk and a word. An enchanter prices the draw and calls it craftsmanship. Pallass bills it as maintenance. Maintenance. Under this city is wardwork by the hand that cut our frame, and it has been drawing since before Liscor had walls. I want to read it standing in front of it.

steps._comment: descent_ask rows: 0 'What do you expect to find?', 1 the accept, 2 'Not today.'

The option's effects array is [quest, accomplishment] and the events land in that order -- the spine's own `return` beat completes on the accomplishment a beat later, closing the quest Phase 6 shipped open.
The spine's LAST beat completes on the same counter -- Phase 6 shipped `return` waiting on exactly this.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Good. I have walked that gauntlet twice and marked the safe line myself, so we will not be dying of a flagstone. Bring your own rope. I am not carrying yours; I have a spine to preserve and a reputation that assumes I never lift anything.

steps._comment: == DOWN TO THE SEAL == teleport into trapped_halls at (18,8), one step off the door's approach cell. dungeon_peek's teleport precedent: the walk down is proven there and by delve_fight; this script's subject is the seal itself.

Act V's two new entities net to ZERO here and the count still moves: seal_warden_alcove (19,6) is an encounter, so it is visible and inert from first arrival (present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters), and pisces_seal_escort (19,8) is present since the descent was agreed -- while ksmvr_plates retires at horns_dig_joined, which this save banked long ago. 12 entities + the PC = 13; v019-L2 makes it 17, the four north-gallery entities (span stub, drop, slab, cache) standing unbanked and present here exactly as they do in dungeon_peek.

== READING 1: the hand == step onto the door's only approach cell (18,7), then bump right into seal_kept_door (19,7) to face it. The bump cannot move (a prop blocks its cell) but it sets facing -- the walkthroughs' own idiom.

payload_contains.text: Pisces reaches the door before you do and stops a handspan short of it. "The same hand. One person's work, and this door was the first of it." He does not look away while he says it.

steps._comment: == READING 2: the appetite == the SAME interact, one state later. Later-satisfied-wins across the prop's variants is what stages the two reads, and it is why a build with no reading Skill still gets the whole fact.

lore_notes: Pisces steps back at last. "The lines run one way. They have run one way for a very long time, and something on the far side has been drinking the whole while. Your inn has a frame by this hand. Sleep well."
Pisces reaches the door before you do and stops a handspan short of it. "The same hand. One person's work, and this door was the first of it." He does not look away while he says it.
[Detect Magic] — Light runs under the turf in one long seam, straight through the stone and away west. The hollow is built on a current.

[Observe] — The grain of the frame isn't grain at all: a pattern worked into the wood, old and deliberate, repeating all the way around the jamb. It holds still while you watch it and shifts the moment you look away.
[Detect Magic] — The socket still remembers its stone: a slow pulse, counting toward a door that already left. The warding reads near-first: the spiral beside the pedestal, then its far twin.

Below the pedestal: not treasure. A door, unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.
East past the gate road, across the floodplains — this is the ruin. Survey stakes, a banked fire, washing on a line: the Horns got here first. The sealed level is deeper in, under the pedestal court.
The fissure Zevara spoke of is down past the gallery. The dark has a direction today.

steps._comment: v0.15 Task 2.2, THE LONG-FORM LORE READ (Phase-1 caveat closure). No shipped script had ever banked more than TWO lore lines, so the tab's actual job -- a record you scroll and re-read -- went unproven. The fixture pre-banks six lines this Act V state implies the player already saw; the run adds its own two, and this pins the WHOLE rendered list, exactly ordered. payload_contains compares an array key as a complete list, which is what makes this a real ordering pin: NEWEST FIRST, so the two reads the player just took lead, and the arrival narration they got in Act III is last.

v0.15 A5: this Act V state reached the vault through the snare fight, and the fixture now SAYS so. Without cleared_halls_by_force it would fall through to the disarmer's ending and the journal would credit a fighter with taking the halls apart trap by trap.

Capture order is the sim's own, and it is the REVERSE of the render: index 0 is the oldest line (carried in by the fixture, proving a pre-populated record survives WISave.apply at version 8), the last index is the read the player took a moment ago.

steps.name: confirm

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: We open it and see what three centuries of feeding produced. Or we leave it fed and make that somebody's paid duty, which is dull, and correct, and I resent both qualities. Or — if your hands are equal to it, which remains unproven — you re-cut the ward yourself and it holds another age without a keeper. I dislike most of these. I will be copying the outer lines while you decide.

steps._comment: Row 1 is the TALK fork: leave it fed and make it somebody's paid duty. He argues for this one.

payload_contains.speaker: Pisces
payload_contains.text: Sensible. Deeply unsatisfying. It will need a real keeper, though, and a real ledger line, or it lapses in a decade and we are back here with worse knees. Olesm keeps the Watch's dread and the Watch's paperwork in the same drawer. Go and tell him what is eating under his city. Spare no detail.

steps._comment: NEGATIVE: pointing at Olesm banks NOTHING. The TALK path's counter is earned at the Guild steps, not at the door -- no path resolves by agreeing with Pisces.

== THE GUILD STEPS == teleport to street (29,5), bump up into Olesm (29,3) from (29,4). He carries a real talk_pool, so the first interact is a bark and the second opens olesm_intro (delve_fight's own approach).

CURSOR: the Act V arm is the last row of Olesm's hub, visible index 6 at this state (the chess invite, the [Appraise Foe] tease VISIBLE-LOCKED, the worry topic, the warren report, the exit, the desk compliment, then the ward). delve_fight pins the same hub one row shorter at its own state; adding this row shifted nothing there, because that fixture cannot hold read_the_feeding_ward.

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Fed, on a schedule, with no end written anywhere. A posting like that sits on the ledger forever. Every quarter, somebody new asks why we're paying a Gnoll to walk down and feed a door, and every quarter somebody has to be brave enough to sign it again.

payload_contains.speaker: Olesm
payload_contains.text: Right. Right. Standing notice, Guild board, renewed by the season: one keeper, one lantern of mana a month, no questions logged about what it feeds. I'm putting my name on it, which means when it lapses it will be my fault. That sits better than not knowing did. Thank you.

steps._comment: == THE FINALE == Olesm's posting banked seal_resolved mid-dialogue, so the game's one true ending rolls the instant that conversation closes -- the same veil/dialogue-end delivery the retired epilogue used, re-pointed off raskghar_sealed and onto seal_resolved. 10 lines = 2 open + 3 class recount (Warrior 5, Mage 5, Diplomat 1, in the save's own insertion order) + 3 region recap (all three lattice counters are banked -- the descent ask is gated on holding all three) + 1 path close (the FED line) + 1 wanderinginn.com curtain. Under QA the paced reveal collapses to this instant emit, so no screenshot can catch it; the windowed machine-playtest owns the look.

THE ONE-SHOT COUNTER. It is sim state, not a runtime flag, so a save/quit can never strand or replay the ending -- and post_game (banked mid-story at the seal sleep) is deliberately NOT what guards it.

== NO RE-FIRE, AND THE SECOND DELIVERY HOOK == sleep at the inn. The veil's sleep path also plays an owed finale (the FIGHT path banks seal_resolved at a container, with no dialogue behind it), so this sleep is the exact call site that must decline: finale_played is already 1.
